title: Ochi Chyornye (Dark Eyes)
attribution: Words by Yevhen Hrebinka (1843; he died in 1848) set to the melody of Florian Hermann's "Valse Hommage" (published 1879) in the arrangement by S. Gerdal published in Moscow in 1884; everything was in print well before 1929, so melody and words are public domain. The chromatic notes (D#, G#, A#, C#) belong to the tune and show as out-of-key.
